scope: Finite-sample Monte Carlo of one-sided positive mean tests; synthetic excess returns only

hac.note: Predeclared sample-size heuristic, not a data-tuned optimal bandwidth

bootstrap.type: stationary bootstrap with common circular time rows across all strategies
bootstrap.pvalue: (1 + number of bootstrap statistics >= observed statistic) / (B + 1)
bootstrap.note: A fixed-scale centered stationary-bootstrap max test; not Hansen SPA. The block-length heuristic is predeclared, not optimized from the results.

random_streams.scheme: SeedSequence(root_seed, spawn_key=(figure, scenario, replicate, purpose)).generate_state(1, uint64)
random_streams.note: Logical addresses are independent of the number of Monte Carlo replicates; extending MC preserves existing replicates. Sensitivity uses figure=4 and a separate bootstrap purpose for each fixed block length.

gaussian_ar.initialization: Exact joint Gaussian stationary law with marginal standard deviation sigma

student_ar.initialization: Zero initial state, discard 512 observations; approximate stationarity
student_ar.innovation: Independent t5 component shocks multiplied by sqrt(3/5), then common/idiosyncratic mixture; neither the mixture nor AR marginal is exactly t5

garch.innovation: Unit-variance mixture of standardized t5 component shocks. Cross_corr controls shock correlation, not exact unconditional return correlation. Mixture fourth moment <= 9.
garch.long_run_std: sigma, since phi=0 and returns are martingale differences

figure_1.theoretical_reference: 1-Phi(z_0.95/sqrt((1+phi)/(1-phi))); IID normal-limit prediction, not a finite-T t-test identity

figure_2.selection: Within each nested prefix, choose the same argmax HAC statistic winner for both IID and HAC naive p-values
figure_2.reuse: Simulate Kmax=50 once and bootstrap Kmax once per replicate; use identical data and resamples for all prefixes

figure_3.alternative: Only strategy 1 has mean delta*theoretical_long_run_std/sqrt(T); other strategies have zero mean
figure_3.reuse: Within process/replicate, reuse null noise, original HAC scale and centered bootstrap across mean shifts (translation invariant)

block_sensitivity.output: CSV only; no extra main figure; not used to tune the main results

uncertainty.interval: 95% pointwise Wilson Monte Carlo interval for a binomial rejection proportion
uncertainty.note: Intervals describe Monte Carlo noise, are not simultaneous across curves, and do not establish uniform bootstrap validity. Finite-sample size errors are retained.
